Catalog models and their state in the local weights folder

Usage:
  lobo models [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for models
      --json   print the listing as JSON (weights, free_bytes, models, runtime)

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
